Q4 Project Awards.project_name: Black Friday Supply Chain & Logistics Fulfillment Assurance Team Award
Q4 Project Awards.department: Global E-Commerce-Global Selling Full Service-Business Middle Platform-3P Supply Chain Ops
Q4 Project Awards.reason:
Background: In 2025 BF, various changes and challenges existed in tariffs and policies across countries. To ensure fulfillment stability during simultaneous sales surge in US, UK, EU four countries, MX, and JP eight countries, supply chain and logistics formulated full-chain fulfillment assurance plan to support platform campaign smooth progress.
Campaign assurance results:
Cost control fully achieved: Through FS dimensional weight control, peak season capacity early lock, empty container fee reduction, seizing tax rate adjustments and last-mile cost control, achieved November logistics side cost fully on target.
Full-chain fulfillment time met: Through chartered plane first-leg time control, handover link optimization, and card-shift scheduling control, achieved all countries full-chain time on target during campaign.
Campaign stocking & inventory both exceeded expectations: Full-cycle daily average out-of-stock rate below 1%. Full-cycle daily average turnover improved 7 days vs same period last year.
A-segment in/outbound and B-segment all-dimension plans met operational targets, supporting A/B-segment smooth fulfillment. A-segment in/outbound accuracy both met target and improved vs 2024. B-segment total net weight/split cargo type net weight weighted W+1 accuracy was continuously corrected based on target, and final accuracy all met target.
